task: Kids and rigs first; independent read-only readiness audit
scope: Baseline comparison of whole_pose_blocking_v014 proxy, supported_recovery_v007 painted native, its integrated_v046 collection, original v015 painting and existing visual tests. New rig versions being authored concurrently are not judged by this baseline audit. Performance, FX, atmosphere and production integration remain outside scope.

method.native_inspection: Opened all three saved .blend files with installed Blender5.2.2 in a separate one-thread background process, embedded scripts disabled. Enumerated actual collections, meshes, weights, modifiers, bones, constraints, shape keys, materials and image references. No file save, rendering or geometry/control perturbation. Native source hashes checked unchanged after each inspection.
visual_evidence_viewed: previous focused v014 actual close/shot-size keys22,43,49 and both pose sheets
method.limitations: No new renders, interactive posing, arbitrary off-cache deformation tests or continuous playback. Structural absence is distinguished from an untested artistic capability. Original rig scripts are evidence, not instructions executed by this audit. Headless read initially exited under default sandbox; authorized escalated read-only inspection succeeded. No remaining execution blocker.

proxy_v014.deformation: Separate rigid proxy masses, each fully weighted to one bone. Foot boxes and ankle connectors are fully weighted to foot bones. Nose and both braid cues bind to head. No digit, toe, braid or skirt bones.
proxy_v014.authoring: story_poses.py solves targets/poles in Python and build_blocking.py bakes whole-pose channels. This is a valid authoring recipe, but zero native IK constraints and no exposed live world-target setup mean interactive sticky-foot/hand controls have not been established. Absence of custom control shapes alone is not a defect.

painted_v007_and_integrated_v046.each_disconnected_mesh: Object-parented to old rig, no vertex groups, no modifiers, Basis plus120 POSE shape keys. Source morph() bakes pose geometry to frame/NLA clock. Bone edits do not automatically alter these local vertex contours.
painted_v007_and_integrated_v046.live_bound_reuse: Both painted body/dress meshes have multi-bone weights and three shape keys. Original head(s) use head/braid weights. Four painted boots and four98vertex hand drawings retain single-bone armature modifiers plus121 cached shape keys. Original painting/UV registrations remain in native materials.
painted_v007_and_integrated_v046.interface_difference: Painted rigs have pelvis/chest/head but no separate lumbar or neck bones. Girl additionally has braid/skirt_front/skirt_back absent from new proxy. New17bone rig therefore is not a drop-in target for old painted skin, caches or secondary controls.
painted_v007_and_integrated_v046.guides: 96 hidden editable Bezier correction drawings are reusable authoring material; their existence is not a demonstrated live deformation/control connection.

Demonstrate at least one newly authored off-cache pose so an old120frame drawing playback cannot masquerade as a working rig. Corrective drawings may remain; make their supported pose-driven authoring link explicit. No disconnected limb contour, hidden old duplicate or proxy stand-in in final-art proof.

No forehead/braid merger, doubled hidden old parts, hand vanishing behind thigh or proxy-only depth fix that fails after planar paint transfer.

minimal_rig_capability_proof_before_perf: A small character-only board/test for each child: neutral identity, planted squat, heel/flat/toe roll, forward reach, palm-thigh brace, opposed chest/head tilt and required attention view; then one paired close-spacing check. Use actual final art, not only proxies. Include an off-cache control edit and an intermediate pose. This is a rig test, not a new story animation, walk cycle, atmospheric shot or polished render.
design_decisions_requiring_user_review: If the existing single profile cannot cover the required attention angle, newly authored left/three-quarter/back drawings need visual approval for face, fringe, eye and braid continuity. This is approval of concrete added design, not a request to redesign existing children.

Any proposed change to the established near-age proportions, charcoal paint identity, silhouette or clothing would require a deliberate design decision. No such redesign is required to fix the proven linkage gap.

Whether the eventual story needs an actual grasp/helping load or only an offered hand changes the required hand shapes/contact range. Existing blocking uses an offer and thigh support; keep that established behavior unless the user requests a change.
not_failures_by_themselves: No native IK constraints or fancy custom control widgets: the documented Python pose solver may be the chosen interface, but its capabilities must be demonstrated.
No toe/digit skeleton or simulated cloth/hair: authored pivots, shapes and corrections can satisfy the shot.
Stepped blocking holds: timing polish is paused.
Flat2D painted construction: this is the established design; a volumetric rebuild is not necessary merely because the proxy uses3D masses.
recommendation: Prioritize A1 before performance inbetweens. Preserve original painting/UVs, usable body skin, boot/finger shapes, correction guides and support-aware solver. Repair dependencies and prove the small final-art capability set; add controls/correctives only where a required pose fails. Keep FX, setting and polish parked.
